memory_verse.label: Bible Portion
memory_verse.text: "Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, 'You have brought trouble on me by making me obnoxious to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.' But they replied, 'Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?'" - Gen 34:30-31 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter ends without resolution, and it leaves us uneasy. Jacob finally speaks — but listen to his complaint. He rebukes Simeon and Levi not for the horror of what they did, not for the innocent lives destroyed, but for the trouble it might bring on him: "You have brought trouble on me... I and my household will be destroyed." Even now, his concern seems centred on himself and his safety.

The brothers, for their part, have the last word: "Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?" Their question carries real weight — the wrong done to Dinah was outrageous, and no one should minimise it. Yet their protest, however heartfelt, cannot justify the slaughter of a city. Both sides have a point, and both are deeply in the wrong. Here is a whole family without a clear moral compass, each responding out of self-interest or unchecked passion.

How did they end up here? This tragedy unfolded after Jacob settled near Shechem, rather than returning fully to Bethel and to the Lord, as God had called him to do (Gen 31:13). A family that had drifted from a close walk with God was left to stumble through a crisis without His guidance.

The lesson is quiet but clear: when we drift from God, we lose our compass. Stay close to Him, for His presence and His Word are what keep our hearts and homes from losing their way.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Where might your family or you have drifted from a close walk with God?
Do you face crises with God's guidance, or by self-interest and passion?
What would it look like to return fully to the "Bethel" God calls you to?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, keep my heart and my home from drifting away from You. Be our compass in every crisis, and draw us back into a close walk with You, that we may not lose our way. Amen.
